item.title: Las Vegas military veteran's dispute with mortgage lender stymied by national politics
item.description: An elderly Marine veteran's dispute with his mortgage servicer may be exacerbated by the after-effects of the Trump administration's dismantling of a federal agency designed to help consumers dissatisfied with their banks and other financial institutions, an 8 News Now investigation reveals.

item.title: New York man dead after ramming power substation outside Las Vegas
item.description: One person is dead after he rammed a power substation outside Boulder City, sources told the 8 News Now Investigators.

item.title: Nevada leaders celebrate new law bringing $50M to Hoover Dam
item.description: Nevada Democratic Rep. Susie Lee and Nevada Democratic Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto joined Puoy Premsrirut, Chairwoman of the Colorado River Commission, to highlight the bipartisan, bicameral Help Hoover Dam Act, which was recently signed into law and will free up about $50 million for long‑needed maintenance at the Hoover Dam.

item.title: Las Vegas continues to be a terrorism target, sheriff says
item.description: Las Vegas Metro Police Department Sheriff Kevin McMahill announced the launch of the Meridian Project, a technologically advanced program to protect Las Vegas from terrorist attacks, which will include a 24/7 global intelligence and counter-terrorism capability, a 24/7 real-time analysis desk, and a global intelligence network in key cities and international locations.

item.title: Pahrump crash leaves pedestrian dead, troopers say
item.description: The Nevada Highway Patrol, a is investigating a fatal crash involving a pedestrian Saturday in Pahrump.

item.title: Nevada fire marshal, councilman arrested for DUI, booked into jail
item.description: Nevada's state fire marshal, a top leader within the Department of Public Safety, was booked into jail Saturday morning on a DUI charge, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.

item.title: Meet the Las Vegas officer who adopted dog abandoned at Harry Reid Airport
item.description: A Las Vegas Metropolitan police officer and his family have officially adopted a dog who was abandoned at Harry Reid International Airport earlier this month, giving him his forever home.

item.title: Las Vegas police: Man shot roommate, set home on fire
item.description: The Las Vegas Metropolitan Police have identified the suspect arrested in connection with a deadly shooting and house fire Friday night in the east valley.

item.title: Homeland Security stops TSA PreCheck, Global Entry programs
item.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.
